acceptance_predicates.description: TUI source is cloned and built outside the destination before installation.
Install either completes with a validated manifest or leaves the previous installation intact.
Launch passes the exact versioned environment/control handoff and reports incompatibility clearly.
Build failures, cancellation, rollback, and remove clean temporary artifacts and child processes.

definition_of_done: Bounded materializer runner and lifecycle tests pass on protected main.
Independent review validates no direct writes to product main checkouts.

inputs.description: Validated channel and exact source provenance.

outputs.description: Atomic install, rollback, cleanup, and launch receipt.

gates.description: Clean-clone install, rollback, remove, and launch-negative matrix passes.
